requirements.text: This requirement is being considered as a total small business set-aside under NAICS 541512 with a size standard of $34 million.
Respondents must be registered and active in SAM.gov at the time of response.
Respondents must hold an active FedRAMP Moderate authorization or be a partner of a FedRAMP Moderate authorized cloud service provider.
4.1 The contractor shall migrate approximately 400 on-premises workloads from the Kansas City and Ogden data centers to a FedRAMP Moderate cloud environment within 24 months of award.
4.2 The contractor shall provide 24x7 managed operations including monitoring, patching and incident response for all migrated workloads.
4.3 The contractor shall develop a migration wave plan within 45 calendar days of award.
4.4 The contractor shall maintain a Recovery Time Objective of four hours and a Recovery Point Objective of one hour for Tier 1 applications.
4.5 The contractor must ensure that all personnel with access to Federal Tax Information complete IRS Publication 1075 background investigations before access is granted.
4.6 The contractor should propose an approach for FinOps cost optimization and monthly cost reporting.
4.7 The contractor shall provide a transition-out plan 90 days before the end of the contract.
Responses shall not exceed 10 pages, excluding the cover page.
Use 12-point Times New Roman font with one-inch margins on letter-size paper.
Submit the capability statement as a single PDF file.
File names shall follow the pattern CompanyName_IRS_SS_0042.pdf.
Include the company name, UEI, CAGE code, business size and socio-economic status on the cover page.
Responses must be emailed to the Contracting Officer at market.research@irs.example.gov no later than 2:00 PM Eastern Time on October 30, 2026.
The email subject line must read 'Sources Sought 2032H5-26-SS-0042 - Company Name'.
Questions must be submitted in writing by October 16, 2026; telephone inquiries will not be accepted.
Responses will be reviewed for demonstrated experience migrating at least 200 workloads for a federal agency within the past three years.
The Government will assess the relevance of past performance in FedRAMP Moderate environments handling Federal Tax Information.
The Government will consider the respondent's ability to provide cleared staff in Kansas City, Missouri and Ogden, Utah.
Capability statements should identify any teaming or subcontracting arrangements and the percentage of work to be performed by the small business prime.
